title: Text Input: Text input with data list suggestion (daisyUI)
notes:
Text Input is a simple input field.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/input/+page.md
code:
<input type="text" class="input" placeholder="Which browser do you use" list="browsers" />
<datalist id="browsers">
  <option value="Chrome"></option>
  <option value="Firefox"></option>
  <option value="Safari"></option>
  <option value="Opera"></option>
  <option value="Edge"></option>
</datalist>
